consequence.statement: The removed containerRuntime.integration value no longer takes effect; for crio the documented crio instructions must be followed instead.
consequence.remediation: Remove containerRuntime.integration from values and, if using crio, follow the crio instructions in the upgrade notes.

original.statement: The deprecated Helm value containerRuntime.integration is removed; values set for it no longer take effect, and crio users should follow the crio instructions.

decision.reason: [ev-5e90ba383ca7] (1.16 Upgrade Notes › Helm Options) says the deprecated Helm option `containerRuntime.integration` is removed, and tells crio users to check the crio instructions. The values validators confirm the key exists in the source values [ev-28e0ccb5774a] and is missing from the target values [ev-39a22d88e2f5]. A removed Helm key that an operator still sets is no longer honoured, which is exactly what setting-ignored covers (removed key → mandatory work). The proposed statement and remediation stay within what the evidence says.
